summary.title: Monthly Sonar review workflow and targeted quality remediation #433
outcomes: Centralized Sonar scanner invocation and prerequisite validation
Parity-oriented local coverage preparation for Kotlin, web, and Rust inputs
Fail-closed operator-facing workflow behavior for missing prerequisites

notes: This change is primarily workflow/operational rather than a focused runtime unit-test slice.
A cargo test probe using a sonar filter timed out and was not treated as authoritative verification.
Verification evidence is based on checked tasks plus direct inspection of Makefile, scripts/sonar.sh, and the hosted Sonar workflow.
Apply documentation was persisted after implementation/testing had already been completed.
This artifact exists to complete the OpenSpec audit chain for the change folder.
